---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
---

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = as.integer,
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, color = "#2b6cb0", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100 Trajectories (2000)",
    subtitle = "Weekly ranking of songs from their entry onto the chart",
    x = "Week on Chart",
    y = "Chart Rank (1 is top)",
    caption = "Source: tidyr::billboard"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
